import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
data['parsed_date'] = pd.to_datetime(data['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
acct = data[data['account_id'] == 'e0yOWue'].copy()

# Group by full resource combination
keys = ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
grp = acct.groupby(['parsed_date'] + keys)['unblended_cost'].sum().reset_index()

# Pivot to check per-group: anomaly day vs same weekday history and z-score vs prior days
anom_date = pd.Timestamp('2025-10-13')
results = []
for name, g in grp.groupby(keys):
    g = g.set_index('parsed_date')['unblended_cost'].asfreq('D')
    pre = g.loc[:'2025-10-12'].dropna()
    if len(pre) < 7:
        continue
    anom = g.get(anom_date, np.nan)
    if np.isnan(anom):
        continue
    mu = pre.iloc[-14:].mean()
    sd = pre.iloc[-14:].std()
    dow = g[g.index.dayofweek == anom_date.dayofweek].dropna()
    dow_prior = dow.loc[:'2025-10-06']
    z = (anom - mu) / (sd + 1e-9)
    results.append({'key': name, 'anom': anom, 'mu14': mu, 'z': z,
                    'dow_mean': dow_prior.mean(), 'dow_diff': anom - dow_prior.mean()})
res = pd.DataFrame(results)
res = res.sort_values('z', key=abs, ascending=False)
print(res.head(15).to_string())

r = pd.DataFrame(rows)
r['az'] = r['z'].abs()
print("Global top (day, family) by |weekday-adjusted z|:")
